dialogues.speaker: Ragged Records
dialogues.text: "The blizzard has died down, which is lucky. Hopefully, it's a good sign."

dialogues.speaker: Ragged Records
dialogues.text: "Finally took Ingbert out. Wasn't able to deal with Luther under the circumstances, but with that wound, it shouldn't be a problem."

dialogues.speaker: Ragged Records
dialogues.text: "Next, I'll head <color=#00E1FFFF>east to where the mountain meets the sea</color>. If I can make it that far, I have a chance of survival..."
